newsitem.title: UK: EMS/Mark mostly firm on crosses, punt bucks trend.
newsitem.headline: EMS/Mark mostly firm on crosses, punt bucks trend.

text.p: 0746 GMT - Mark stays firm on most crosses, helped by drops in dollar/mark and stg/mark Monday, but weakens vs Irish punt as punt recovers in line with sterling rebound this morning.
* Punt at 2.6750/80 marks after sliding to low of 2.6618 earlier, nearly back at late Monday Europe level of 2.6795/45.
* German "wise man" Peffekoven, member of Council of Economic Advisors, says two-year delay to EMU would be preferable to launching weak euro in 1999.
* German May c/a balance 2.5 bln marks deficit vs forecast 0.3 bln deficit, trade surplus 9.8 bln vs forecast 10.4 bln.
* French June consumer spending -2.9 pct vs forecast -0.4. Mark at 3.3715/19 francs vs late Monday's 3.3710/15.
* EU official says Finland's commitment to meet EMU criteria not in doubt despite upward revision in 1996 budget deficit to 3.1 pct of GDP. Finmin in talks with ministries on 1998 budget.
* Italy 1997 budget largely on course to meet deficit-cutting targets, Italy's Agi news agency quotes Treasury as saying. Mark/lira at 974.20/50 vs Monday's 972.65/95.
* Italy June wage inflation 4.6 pct y/y vs May's +4.7.
